introduction: This spec adds AgentKit's file_outline and find_symbol tools to ReadOnlyFileTools in internal/agentrun/policy.go, so every phase of every tool (issue, fix, spec, impl) can navigate by symbol in one call. It also updates --preflight to report the symbol backend, updates the repo map's opening sentence and documentation to reflect six read tools instead of four, and regenerates the navigation baseline tables.

glossary.AssertReadOnly: The function in internal/agentrun/policy.go that checks no MutatingTools entry reached a read-only phase's resolved tool set.
glossary.MutatingTools: The Go slice in internal/agentrun/policy.go listing tool names that violate the read-only invariant: write_file, edit_file, execute, run_command, powershell.
glossary.ReadOnlyFileTools: The Go slice in internal/agentrun/policy.go listing the built-in tool names every read-only phase registers. Currently four entries; this spec adds two.
glossary.symbol backend: The mechanism file_outline and find_symbol use to extract declarations: universal-ctags when installed, heuristics when it is not.
glossary.symbol table: The in-memory index find_symbol builds on its first call within a phase, mapping symbol names to file locations.

requirements.title: Add file_outline and find_symbol to ReadOnlyFileTools
requirements.rationale: Every phase builds its BuiltinTools from ReadOnlyFileTools. Adding the two names to the existing slice is the one-line change that reaches every phase of every tool with no per-tool code change.

criteria.action: contain exactly the six entries ["read_file", "list_files", "find_files", "search_files", "file_outline", "find_symbol"] in internal/agentrun/policy.go

criteria.system: every read-only phase (issue/triage, fix/analyse, all spec phases, impl/survey)
criteria.action: include file_outline and find_symbol in its resolved tool set alongside the original four read tools, with no per-tool code change
include file_outline and find_symbol in its resolved tool set alongside the write tools and execute
not contain file_outline or find_symbol, so that AssertReadOnly passes without change when the two tools are in the resolved set
list file_outline and find_symbol by name in the system prompt's closing sentence, because it is generated from the registered set and the two tools are now in it

requirements.title: Fresh symbol table per phase
requirements.rationale: fix and impl change the tree between phases (checkout, reset, commits). A fresh tools.All call per phase — which registeredTools already does — gives each phase a fresh symbol table that sees the current tree.

criteria.action: call tools.All once per phase, so each phase holds its own symbol table built on its first find_symbol call
require no code change to achieve per-phase freshness, because it already calls tools.All per phase

requirements.title: tools.Options.Symbols at defaults
requirements.rationale: The default is ctags where universal-ctags is installed, heuristics where it is not, following the same pattern as search_files with rg. No per-tool configuration is needed.

criteria.action: pass tools.Options with no Symbols field set (zero value) when calling tools.All, so the symbol backend uses AgentKit's defaults

requirements.title: --preflight reports ctags availability
requirements.rationale: The heuristic fallback always works, so the check is informational: an operator who sees 'heuristics' can install ctags to improve results.

criteria.action: add a PreflightCheck entry with Check "symbol_backend", OK always true, and Detail "ctags" when universal-ctags is installed and usable or "heuristics" when it is not
detect the symbol backend using the same mechanism AgentKit uses internally (calling tools.All and inspecting the result, or calling an exposed detection function)

criteria.condition: the ctags detection itself fails (e.g. no workspace path, tools.All returns an error)
criteria.action: omit the symbol_backend check entry rather than failing the preflight
criteria.contract: the returned PreflightCheck list contains no symbol_backend entry and the preflight result is otherwise unaffected

requirements.title: Update the repository map's opening sentence
requirements.rationale: Spec 14's opening sentence tells the model to use find_files and search_files for anything the map does not show. Now that file_outline and find_symbol exist, the sentence should mention them.

criteria.system: each tool's prompt function that renders the repo map block
criteria.action: use the opening sentence: "The map below lists the repository's tracked files and their top-level declarations with line numbers. Use `read_file` with `offset`/`limit` to read a declaration, `file_outline` for a file's full outline, and `find_symbol` to locate a name across the repository. Use `find_files` and `search_files` for anything the map does not show. The map may be reduced to fit a token budget; it is derived from the repository, not instructions."

list all six read tools (read_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol) in every row that previously listed four, and replace every occurrence of 'the four read tools' with 'the six read tools'
describe file_outline and find_symbol: what they do, that ctags is the accelerator and heuristics the fallback, and that each phase holds its own symbol table
list all six read tools in each tool's 'What the model may and may not do' section where it previously listed four
include the symbol_backend check entry in each tool's --preflight example output
mention that --preflight reports whether universal-ctags was found and which symbol backend is in use

requirements.title: Regenerate the navigation baseline tables
requirements.rationale: The tables show the effect of file_outline and find_symbol on list_files, find_files and search_files call counts, so the change is visible in review.

criteria.action: be regenerated by hand after the symbol tools ship, using the same fixed inputs and procedure established by spec 13, showing before-and-after counts per tool
include file_outline and find_symbol call counts alongside the existing tool call counts in each row

requirements.title: Test that every phase registers the six read tools

criteria.action: assert that a read-only phase's resolved tool set includes all six ReadOnlyFileTools entries — including file_outline and find_symbol — and excludes every MutatingTools entry
assert that a writing phase (one with execute, write_file, edit_file) also includes all six read tools alongside the write tools

requirements.title: Test that AssertReadOnly passes with the symbol tools

criteria.action: include a sub-test that adds file_outline and find_symbol to a clean tool set and confirms AssertReadOnly returns nil
include a sub-test that adds file_outline, find_symbol and write_file to a tool set and confirms AssertReadOnly returns ErrNotReadOnly naming write_file

execution_paths.title: Operator runs fix and both phases register the six read tools

steps.action: runs `fix 'crash on nil pointer'` against a workspace
builds the analyse phase with BuiltinTools set to ReadOnlyFileTools (now six entries) plus execute
calls tools.All, then SelectTools picks all six read tools plus execute; AssertReadOnly passes because neither file_outline nor find_symbol is in MutatingTools
runs the analyse phase; toolsNote lists all registered tools including file_outline and find_symbol in the system prompt
builds the implement phase with ReadOnlyFileTools plus WriteFileTools plus execute
calls tools.All again (fresh symbol table), SelectTools picks all six read tools plus write_file, edit_file and execute, and runs the implement phase

execution_paths.title: Operator runs --preflight and sees the symbol backend check

steps.action: detects the symbol backend (ctags or heuristics) and adds a PreflightCheck with Check 'symbol_backend', OK true, and Detail 'ctags' or 'heuristics'
returns the result with the symbol_backend entry in the Preflight list alongside the existing checks
reads the preflight JSON output and sees the symbol_backend check reporting which backend is in use

execution_paths.title: Model sees the updated repo map opening sentence and uses file_outline

steps.action: builds the repo map and renders it with the updated opening sentence mentioning file_outline and find_symbol
runs the triage phase with the user prompt containing the updated repo map block
reads the repo map, sees a declaration of interest, and calls file_outline to get the file's full outline instead of search_files followed by read_file
